_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: Replaces Rail x8, Post x60, PostLight x60 in buildPlaza(). Fence line 55 studs from the plaza centre (edge = half - 1). Per side: posts at u = k * 7.857 for k = -6..6 (13 Fence_Post + Fence_PostGlow), corners at k = +-7 (Fence_Corner + the game's gumball), 14 Fence_Rail segments centred at u = (k + 0.5) * 7.857, k = -7..6. All origins on the plaza floor (height 0).

Fence_Post.note: turn so its X axis runs along the fence (rail grommets are on +-X)

Fence_Rail.note: one segment, post centre to post centre (7.857); X along the fence

Fence_Corner.note: rail rings on its -X and +Z sides (Roblox; Blender -X and -Y): turn it so those face along the two fence runs
